explanation: Requested phi* = 370 deg is outside the valid [0, 360) range and fails preflight. It is physically equivalent to 370 - 360 = 10 deg, so it was normalized to phi* = 10 deg before generating the input. All other kinematics (W = 1.7 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*) = 0.5) passed preflight with no issues (W is well above the eta+p threshold of 1.4861 GeV and cos(theta*) is far from the +/-1 poles). Generated the eta-channel EXCLURAD input using the default CLAS12 RG-K beam energy (6.53 GeV, the validated eta campaign) and default vcut = 0.166 GeV^2, with rc_mode = full O(alpha) (mode 0), the validated setting. Note: other CLAS12 beam energies (10.6, 10.2 GeV) are also valid and would give different radiative corrections.
